content.text:
Software engineer with 4+ years of experience building backend services, data pipelines, and internal platforms. Strong in
TypeScript, Python, Go, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and cloud-native systems. Experienced with event-driven processing,
web scraping, observability, and practical machine-learning integration.

bullets: Designed and maintained TypeScript and Go services handling approximately 1.5 million API requests per day.
Built a PostgreSQL-backed job processing system with retry policies, idempotency, and structured application logs.
Reduced median API latency by 38% by profiling database queries, adding targeted indexes, and introducing Redis caching.

Developed Playwright-based data collectors that ran independently across multiple sources and persisted normalized results to
SQLite.
Integrated local LLM inference for structured text extraction using JSON schemas and deterministic post-processing.
Implemented REST endpoints and background tasks in Python using FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
Created ETL scripts for CSV and API datasets, including validation, deduplication, and daily reporting.
Added Docker-based local development environments and CI checks that reduced environment-related onboarding issues.
Wrote unit and integration tests for authentication, billing, and data-import workflows.
Coursework: Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, Advanced Databases, Cloud Computing.

paragraphs: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, SQL, Java
Node.js, Express, FastAPI, REST APIs, WebSockets, background workers
PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, BigQuery, pandas, ETL/ELT pipelines
AWS, GCP, Docker, GitHub Actions, Linux, Nginx
scikit-learn, sentence-transformers, Ollama, embeddings, LLM structured extraction

subheadings: LinkedOut - Local Job Discovery & Resume Matching Platform
bullets: Built a TypeScript + Playwright pipeline for collecting job listings and details into SQLite.

Implemented resume and job-description extraction using deterministic parsing, NER enrichment, local LLM inference, and
explainable scoring.

Designed the pipeline so embeddings and semantic retrieval can be added later without changing the source-of-truth data
model.
Created a Go backend and WebSocket stream for live application metrics with PostgreSQL persistence.
Containerized services with Docker and deployed a small production environment on AWS.

subheadings: Certifications: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (2024); Google Cloud Digital Leader (2023)
